saved_screen.interpretation: Reused the saved screen; did not repeat its 32 calls. Synthetic author labels and this small screen do not establish field accuracy, calibration, safety qualification, or permit compliance.

pattern_review.EL01: Primary symptom classification has explicit precedence, does not diagnose cause, and leaves the immediate burning/heat escalation to code. No defect confirmed.
pattern_review.EL02: The question classifies reported hazard signs only; the on-site electrician and lockout/de-energizing procedures remain authoritative in code. The result must not be treated as a safety determination. No defect confirmed.
pattern_review.EL03: The model classifies work type only; jurisdiction-specific permit rules, revision, and fee remain code-owned. No permit decision is inferred. No defect confirmed.
pattern_review.EL04: The contract uses named project roles and an explicit utility/electrical/other-trade/owner precedence for mixed items. The challenge rationale describes an item whose utility action is a prerequisite; routing does not decide payment responsibility. The fixed precedence remains a policy choice to check against local dispatch practice, not evidence of a model defect.
pattern_review.EL05: The question classifies inspector note wording; the jurisdiction record remains authoritative and disagreement is escalated. Partial approvals with corrections have explicit precedence. No defect confirmed.
pattern_review.EL06: The question reads the first requested office action; dates, uploads, fees, and tracking remain code-owned. The challenge distinguishes message subject framing from the first request in the body. No defect confirmed.
pattern_review.EL07: The question classifies protection function, while code compares required_type and exact ratings/listing. The current state carries required_type even though instructions say not to compare it; a contrastive Jev pair with the same explicit AFCI-only description and required_type values gfci/afci selected afci at confidence 1.0 in both. This one pair found no output change but does not establish invariance; the question was not versioned.
pattern_review.EL08: The model reads only the technician's text description. Code attaches the actual photo and leaves acceptance to the inspector; a description is explicitly not treated as the photo. No defect confirmed.
